about: Each devnet program as deployed: its id, the commit whose program code it was built from (the last to change that code; later commits to b279a06 changed comments only), and the length and sha256 of the deployed program (the account's data up to that length; the rest is zeros). A build embeds its source paths, so a build from another tree or path is other bytes: scripts/verify-devnet.sh compares devnet with this record, not with target/deploy. Recorded on 2026-10-09 from solana program dump, each equal to the pre-move build then in target/deploy.
